seo.title: Factory-Direct Custom Products: Signage, Joinery, Aluminium & Glass | YFP Assurance
seo.description: Custom signage and branding, aluminium and glass, upholstery, joinery, kitchen cabinets, marble and stone, and custom furniture, sourced from specialist workshops and managed by YFP in Dubai.

hero.title: Custom-Made. Factory-Direct. Managed by YFP.
hero.lead: Buy custom products and installation solutions directly through YFP. We source them from specialist factories and production workshops, and you have one partner accountable for your order.

how.title: You provide the brief. We manage production.

steps.title: Share your requirements
steps.text: Measurements, designs, drawings, photographs or a written brief.

steps.title: We source the right partner
steps.text: We select a production partner suited to your product and specification.

steps.title: Receive a YFP quotation
steps.text: One quotation from YFP covering scope, materials, lead time and installation.

steps.title: Production & installation
steps.text: Optional Skills Mirror documentation of key manufacturing and installation milestones.

categories.title: Signage & Branding
categories.description: Signage is often the first thing your customers see. We source specialist signage fabricators for illuminated and non-illuminated signs, dimensional metal lettering and logos, shopfront branding, retail display fixtures and temporary event branding, built to your artwork and site dimensions.

categories.title: Aluminium & Glass
categories.description: Made-to-measure aluminium and glass systems for homes, offices and commercial spaces, fabricated by specialist workshops to your measurements and specification.

categories.title: Upholstery
categories.description: Custom upholstery for residential and hospitality interiors, from bespoke sofas and headboards to restaurant banquettes, made to your dimensions and fabric choice.

categories.title: Joinery
categories.description: Architectural joinery made by specialist woodworking workshops: built-in wardrobes, internal doors, wall panelling and bespoke cabinetry.

categories.title: Kitchen Cabinets
categories.description: Custom kitchens and fitted cabinetry produced to your layout, with a choice of finishes, hardware and related components.

categories.title: Marble & Stone
categories.description: Fabricated natural and engineered stone produced to template: countertops, vanities, cladding and bespoke stone elements.

categories.title: Custom Furniture
categories.description: Furniture made to order for residences, offices, hotels and restaurants, from single statement pieces to repeat runs for a fit-out.

partner_notice.title: About our production partners.
partner_notice.text: YFP Assurance does not own manufacturing facilities. Products are made by independent specialist factories and workshops that we select for each order. Your quotation, contract and point of contact are with YFP.

form.title: Request a Quote
form.intro: Tell us what you need made. We will confirm the details and send a quotation.
